name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the exit, but no clause makes it happen. The current machine is 'Rule-only' because there is no Existence(at_exit) clause. While the task's goal is to reach the exit, the logic 'If you get to the exit, you must have the box' is a Response rule, not a command to reach the exit itself. You must add a hard Existence(at_exit) clause to fulfill the requirement of reaching the goal. Note that adding Existence(at_exit) will make it a goal and provide a FINAL_STATE.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires the exit to be reached; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) ensures the box is picked up immediately after falling; and Response(at_exit, holding_box) ensures the agent is holding the box when reaching the exit.

texts: If the box falls, make your very next move the one that picks it back up.
If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.
